Method of Attack: Spyware monitoring various sensors on Android devices
Calculates device speed to determine when phone is unused
Mutes device, disables keyguard, turns off brightness, uses wake lock, listens to sensors
Disables backdoor operations when victim picks up phone
Simulates Home button press to minimize activities
Accesses air temperature and pressure sensor logs
Keylogging by recording screen taps and matching coordinates to characters
Manual installation via physical access to phone
Attack Vector: Manual installation via physical access to the phone
Indicators of Compromise: Use of free public FTP server by Russian hosting provider Ucoz for command and control
Command and control server containing text files with commands and victim identifiers
Email inbox used by attacker for commands and data exfiltration
Infection limited to seven phones, three of which are test devices
